name: Necromancer: Icebound Champion buff and its immunities end when the Champion dies (#4140)
contract: Icebound Champion 807813 summons creature 500484 for 20000 ms (DurationIndex 18) and reads '...prevents you from being silenced or interrupted and reduces the pushback suffered ... by $807812s1% for $d.' The Champion carries passive 807812, whose three effects are SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_OWNER, radius index 12 (100 yd): effect 0 SPELL_AURA_REDUCE_PUSHBACK BasePoints 49 + DieSides 1 = 50, effect 1 SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_IMMUNITY MiscValue 26 (interrupt), effect 2 SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_IMMUNITY MiscValue 9 (silence). The owner is therefore immune to Silence 15487 (spell Mechanic 9) and to Kick 1766 effect 0 (SPELL_EFFECT_INTERRUPT_CAST, EffectMechanic 26) while the Champion stands. Sacrifice Undead 807938 (family 29 word 2 0x4000000) kills every Necromancer minion, Champions included, about 3 s into the 20 s lifetime; the owner must lose 807812 and both immunities within 2 s instead of keeping them until the timed despawn.

steps.label: Let login and the Life Force aura settle
CONTROL: no Champion buff before the summon
CONTROL: Silence applies before the summon
CONTROL: Kick interrupts before the summon
SETUP: one Icebound Champion is summoned
The Necromancer is aided by the Icebound Champion
The buff reduces spell pushback by 50%
SETUP: the Icebound Champion is dead
DISCRIMINATING: the buff ends with the Champion, not at its 20 s despawn
Silence applies again once the Champion is dead
Kick interrupts again once the Champion is dead
